subject: Ensino Religioso
description_pt: Identificar sentidos do viver e do morrer em diferentes tradições religiosas, através do estudo de mitos fundantes.

components.description_pt: Identificar significados atribuídos ao viver em diferentes tradições religiosas através de mitos fundadores
components.description_en: Identify meanings attributed to living in different religious traditions through founding myths
components.cc_component_description: Compare the treatment of similar themes across stories or myths from different cultures

components.description_pt: Analisar como mitos fundadores comunicam compreensão de uma tradição sobre vida e morte
components.description_en: Analyze how founding myths communicate a tradition's understanding of life and death
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how different cultures portray similar topics in myths and traditional literature

cc_matches.description: Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
